note: Attribution lives here and nowhere else: compare.py has no knowledge of these
entries and cannot be steered by them. Each trap owns (dataset, field) pairs;
'<record>' means a record present on one side only. Pairs owned by more than
one trap are the honest case - a boundary error changes which rows exist, which
renumbers a running counter downstream - and are listed under every trap that
can produce them. A mismatch in a pair no trap owns is reported as unclassified.
